title: "Book A Meeting"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
---

Pick an open slot below to book a meeting. Times are shown in Pacific Time.

```{=html}
<style>
  .sched-wrap {
    margin-top: .35rem;
  }
  .sched-booking {
    --sched-zoom: 0.82;
    border: 1px solid #e6e8eb;
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
    height: calc(100vh - 11rem);
    min-height: 28rem;
    position: relative;
  }
  .sched-booking iframe {
    display: block;
    width: calc(100% / var(--sched-zoom));
    height: calc(100% / var(--sched-zoom));
    border: 0;
    transform: scale(var(--sched-zoom));
    transform-origin: top left;
  }
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sched-booking {
      --sched-zoom: 0.72;
      height: calc(100vh - 10rem);
      min-height: 22rem;
    }
  }
</style>

<div class="sched-wrap">
  <section class="sched-booking" aria-label="Book A Meeting">
    <iframe
      src="https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ0Bdajq29IfzJiu1wIOfuVnWgZp68CcSQE1gJBqtqPvRg_O5lWXRPTdLW3xCwoFNWqxrYnZi7si?gv=true"
      title="Book a meeting with Wesley Zheng"
      loading="lazy"
      referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade">
    </iframe>
  </section>
</div>
```
